alerts.summary: A flaw was found in svglib. A remote attacker could cause a Denial of Service (DoS) by supplying a specially crafted Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) file containing circular or deeply nested internal image references. Because the renderer processes these references without depth limits or cycle detection, parsing the file leads to excessive resource consumption or an application crash.
alerts.title: svglib: svglib: Denial of Service via recursive SVG image references
